import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import pg from 'pg';
import { turbine } from './generated/index.js';
async function main(){
const pool=new pg.Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,options:'-c search_path=durable_generated',max:3,connectionTimeoutMillis:1500,query_timeout:3000,statement_timeout:2500});
pool.on('error',error=>console.error(error));
const db=turbine({pool});
try{
const rows=await db.outbox.findMany({where:{tenant:'A'},select:{eventId:true,title:true,amount:true},orderBy:{position:'asc'},limit:2});
const exact:{eventId:string;title:string|null;amount:string}[]=rows;
// @ts-expect-error numeric retains decimal-string type
const bad:{amount:number}[]=rows;
if(rows[0]){
// @ts-expect-error projection excludes body
rows[0].body;
}
void bad;
assert.deepEqual(exact,[{eventId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',title:'generated ☃',amount:'12345678901234567890.123456789012'}]);
console.log(JSON.stringify({generatedTypedProjection:true,rows:exact}));
}finally{await db.disconnect();assert.equal((await pool.query('SELECT 42 AS answer')).rows[0].answer,42);await pool.end();}}
main().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1});
